name: Corporal Punishment
overview: Scripture teaches that corporal punishment, when administered with love and wisdom, serves as a necessary tool for correction and guidance. The Proverbs emphasize the importance of timely discipline, stating that sparing the rod is equivalent to hating one's son, while proper chastening reflects genuine love. Physical discipline is portrayed as a means to cleanse away evil and to train a child in the right path, ensuring that they do not depart from it in later life. Furthermore, Deuteronomy highlights the role of just judgment in distinguishing righteousness from wickedness, underscoring the principle of accountability that undergirds disciplinary measures.
